instruction: Carry out `C:\Users\user\Desktop\noninv_amp.cir` in native PSpice. Save the native simulator output as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\noninv_amp.out`, then inspect the stepped 1 kHz gain results in that `.out` and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.json`. The JSON must contain `Rf_found`, `Av_dB`, and `Rg`, where `Rf_found` is the smallest stepped `RF_VAL` whose native measured gain reaches at least 20 dB. [Software] Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. Before starting the work, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.
